name: android-migration-inventory
title: Android Migration Inventory
job_to_be_done: Automatically build a migration-grade semantic inventory of an existing Android app using frozen-source page/UI/event/navigation discovery, Android CLI runtime traversal, source-runtime binding, state-level records, and an immutable evidence chain. Use before Android-to-HarmonyOS migration when every page, component, state, function, and transition must be discovered with minimal later manual repair; do not use it to implement HarmonyOS code.

trigger_surface.description: Automatically build a migration-grade semantic inventory of an existing Android app using frozen-source page/UI/event/navigation discovery, Android CLI runtime traversal, source-runtime binding, state-level records, and an immutable evidence chain. Use before Android-to-HarmonyOS migration when every page, component, state, function, and transition must be discovered with minimal later manual repair; do not use it to implement HarmonyOS code.
should_trigger: 自动分析这个 Android 项目的所有页面、控件、状态、功能和跳转。
执行阶段2，用静态扫描和 Android CLI 建立迁移清单。
查清 WebView、反射、网络、数据库和特殊账号状态是否漏扫。
should_not_trigger: 把整个 Android 项目直接迁移到鸿蒙。
生成鸿蒙工程基座并编译。
在 ArkUI 中实现这个页面。
edge_cases: 只做一次普通 Android 代码审查，不需要迁移清单。
只把一个 XML 布局转成 JSON。
手工列出截图里的控件，不运行 Android CLI。

steps: Verify Gate 1, frozen inputs, Android CLI, environments, and distinct Phase 2 roles.
Deterministically discover Page, Component, Event, Transition, State, asset, dynamic-risk, side-effect, and special-scenario candidates from source.
Traverse runtime tasks with Android CLI and bind every atomic candidate to immutable state evidence.
Archive assets and build normalized feature/page/state/environment inventory records with file-line and evidence provenance.
Compute page and advanced gates, seal closure, and return exact PASS or a blocking unresolved backlog.
decision_points: Static findings create candidates, never verified facts; runtime evidence promotes or blocks them.
Unreachable dynamic, side-effect, account, permission, error, or extreme state remains in the coverage denominator.
Only deterministic evaluators may grant PAGE_PASS or Phase 2 PASS.
failure_modes: A small dialog, menu, event, transition, or hidden state is omitted from atomic coverage.
Model confidence or a status field overrides missing evidence.
Reflection, WebView, server-driven UI, database, clipboard, network, or background effects are treated as non-blocking notes.
Evidence or controller anchors are overwritten, stale, ambiguous, or not hash-bound.
